name: SUNLU Easy PA (Easy Nylon / E-PA) @BBL A1 0.2 nozzle
filament_notes:
SUNLU manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 80 C for 6 h.
Manufacturer max speed 150 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed lowered to 3.4 mm3/s (printer profile 12) from the manufacturer's 150 mm/s rating.
Temperature set for ~151 mm/s on this printer: 275 C (first layer 260 C). Manufacturer bands: 250-270 C at 50-100 mm/s; 270-280 C at 100-150 mm/s. Printing much faster or slower than this printer's default process? Adjust the nozzle temperature along those bands.
Product page: 250-270C @50-100, 270-280C @100-150mm/s; bed 30-50C; shrinkage 1.3-1.6%. Wiki: fan OFF, highly hygroscopic, drying 80-110C 4-6h. Shore (HA/HD) 78.5. 1kg max spool.
Source: https://www.sunlu.com/products/easy-pa-nylon-filament
